run.name: Run water
run.description: Runs the faucet until the water reaches a temperature. Uses the faucet's run temperature and flow rate settings for anything not given.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Run at the hottest or coldest available water instead of a set temperature.

flow_rate.name: Flow rate
flow_rate.description: How hard the water runs, as a percentage of full flow.

dispense.name: Dispense water
dispense.description: Pours a measured amount of water, from 1 tablespoon to 1 gallon.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: How much water to pour, in the chosen unit.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the volume. Cups, ounces and gallons are US measures.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Water temperature in °C. Without this or a preset, the faucet uses its default temperature.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Pour the hottest or coldest available water instead of a set temperature.

start.name: Start
start.description: Pour straight away, or get ready and pour when someone waves at the faucet's sensor.

options.on_wave: When I wave at the faucet
